title: Find a serving envelope that survives lost capacity
description: Change the camera workload, sampled frame rate, model profile, and GPU replicas. Then remove one failure domain and watch capacity, tail latency, and temporal quality move together.

failure.label: Remove one serving zone
failure.detail: Lose roughly one third of provisioned replicas while traffic stays constant.

workloads.label: Loading-dock safety
workloads.detail: Moderate camera count with fast events and a strict freshness target.

workloads.label: Checkout tracking
workloads.detail: Many crowded streams make association and post-processing expensive.

workloads.label: High-detail inspection
workloads.detail: Fewer streams, but small defects require a heavier visual profile.

modelProfiles.label: Balanced profile
modelProfiles.detail: A representative starting point for quality and sustained throughput.

modelProfiles.label: Fast profile
modelProfiles.detail: Higher throughput with a quality score below the shared release floor.

modelProfiles.label: Accurate profile
modelProfiles.detail: More visual detail, lower per-replica throughput, and higher base latency.
